nodes.label: Continuous Save System (Implemented Phase 4)
nodes.rationale: Saving is intended to be continuous and invisible rather than a disruptive manual checkpoint.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Persistence Model
nodes.rationale: An append-only WorldEvent journal provides recovery, periodic GameSnapshot records bound replay, and Branch objects preserve alternative timelines.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Branch DAG
nodes.rationale: SQLite WAL stores snapshots, journal entries, and parent-linked branches using a Git-like timeline model.
